entities.name: Ferenc Kölcsey
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ferenc Kölcsey  was a Hungarian poet, literary critic, orator, and politician, noted for his support of the liberal current in Hungary regarding the politics involving the Austrian Empire. He wrote Himnusz, the national anthem of Hungary in 1823.
